w: Swamishri arrived in Houston and inaugurated the newly built sadhus' residence.

In the evening assembly, Swamishri was given a grand welcome by the Akshar Dhvani marching band. In his blessings, Swamishri stressed the importance of satsang in one's life, saying it benefits the individual, family, community, and country. He concluded by encouraging everyone to take advantage of the spiritual and cultural activities organised during the 14-day Mandir Mahotsav.

After an early morning in Toronto, His Divine Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj arrived in Houston airport in a jovial mood. Swamishri inaugurated a newly built utaaro and sant nivaas as he arrived on the mandir site.

In the evening assembly, Swamishri was given a grand welcome by the Akshar Dhwani marching band and a swagat dance. In his blessings, Swamishri stressed the importance of Satsang in one's life, saying it benefits the individual, family, community, and country. He concluded by encouraging everyone to take advantage of the spiritual and cultural activities organized during the 14-day Mandir Mahotsav.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was leaving Delhi for Vadodara. Some devotees were with him on the aeroplane. Swamishri was meeting these devotees one by one. Among them, Neeraj Tanna came to meet him and said to Swamishri, "I believe that whatever there is, is because of you. Now just bless me that our love never breaks."
Swamishri said, "That is for you to see to, isn't it!"
Neeraj Tanna said, "But you have to keep holding my hand, don't you!"

Swamishri said, "Whatever happens, our niyam and dharma must always remain firm. Live life believing that God is antaryami and 'God sees everything'. There should be no slipping in eating and drinking or anywhere."
In the same way, Harishbhai Bhuptani came for darshan. He said, "We offer a thal (food offering) every day in our home shrine. Do you accept it in the same way as you eat now?"
Swamishri said, "God does eat. Even if it is not seen, he does eat. If we do not understand this, a lack of faith will creep in."
Then Hitesh Contact (Washington) came for darshan. Hitesh said, "Our wish is to cover you in gold."
Swamishri said, "Shriji Maharaj has forbidden this for sadhus. For us sadhus there should be nothing like that at all. Our glory lies in adorning God."
Hitesh said, "Bhagatji Maharaj used to say, 'If you want to cover me in gold, understand the glory of every devotee.'"

Swamishri said, "That is right. Work while understanding the glory of everyone. Whoever understands the glory of everyone will come close to me. Understand the glory of everyone, young and old. If all this is understood, ego will not remain."
Hitesh said, "My wish is to buy the whole village of Chansad."

Swamishri said, "Leave all that. However much satsang takes root here (in the heart), that much it has taken root in the world. Put on the shoes (serve the devotees humbly). Everything is included in that. In that are included Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and all the muktas. All the sadhus and devotees are included in that."
Finally Ghanshyam Rampariya came. He said to Swamishri, "Only by your grace do we have big businesses. Now bless us that satsang becomes the main thing for us."

Swamishri said, "We may move about outside, we may have to go out for business, but always keep satsang as the main thing. My blessings that your intellect stays good and that you remain firm in niyam and dharma."
In this way Swamishri gave all the devotees who had come with him wonderful memories and inspiration.
Whether Swamishri is on the ground or in the sky, he cannot stay without singing the glory of God. This is his supreme attachment and compassion.

Today was 20 July. At night in Bochasan, when Pramukh Swami Maharaj sat to offer his meal to Thakorji, Bhagwatcharan Swami, sitting in front, reminded him, "Twenty five years ago today, the Suvarna Tula (weighing against gold) of Thakorji took place. What shall we feed Swamishri? Shall we feed him gold?"
While eating, Swamishri said, "Fold both hands and do as he says."
Swamishri explained a special, golden meaning of feeding gold.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj took leave of Delhi and was going to Vadodara. Some devotees were with him on the plane. Swamishri was meeting these devotees one by one. Of these devotees, Neeraj Tanna, who came to meet him, said to Swamishri, "I believe that whatever I have is because of you. Now just bless me that our love never breaks."
Swamishri said, "That is for you to see to, isn't it!"
Neeraj Tanna said, "But you have to keep holding my hand, don't you!"

Swamishri said, "Whatever happens, our niyams and dharma must remain firm. Live life believing that Bhagwan is the inner controller who sees everything. There should be no slip in eating and drinking or anywhere else."
In the same way, Harishbhai Bhupatani came for darshan. He said, "In our home shrine we offer a thal every day, so do you accept it just as you are eating now?"
Swamishri said, "Bhagwan certainly eats. Even if it is not seen, he certainly eats. If we do not understand this, a lack of faith comes in."
Then Hitesh Contact (Washington) came for darshan. Hitesh said, "Our wish is to cover you in gold."
Swamishri said, "Shriji Maharaj has forbidden this for sadhus. For us sadhus there should be nothing like that. Our glory lies in adorning Bhagwan."
Hitesh said, "Bhagatji Maharaj used to say that if you want to cover me in gold, understand the glory of every devotee."

Swamishri said, "Yes, that is right. Work with an understanding of everyone's glory. Whoever understands everyone's glory will come to me. Understand the glory of everyone, young and old. If all this is understood, ego does not remain."
Hitesh said, "My wish is to buy the whole village of Chansad."

Swamishri said, "Leave all that. As much satsang as takes root here (in the heart), that much has happened for the world. Put on the shoes (be ready to serve). Everything is included in that. Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and all the muktas are included in that. The sants and devotees are all included in it."
Finally Ghanshyam Rampariya came. He said to Swamishri, "It is only by your grace that we have big businesses. Now bless us that satsang becomes the main thing in our lives."

Swamishri said, "We may go about outside, we may have to go out for business, but always keep satsang as the main thing. My blessings are that your intellect remains good and your niyams and dharma remain firm."
In this way Swamishri gave wonderful moments to remember and inspiration to all the devotees who had come with him.
Whether Swamishri is on the ground or in the sky, he cannot stay without singing the glory of Bhagwan. This is his supreme attachment and compassion.

"I have two questions to ask all of you..." With these words, after puja, Mahant Swami Maharaj began a discourse based on the words of his favourite book "Purushottam Bolya Prite." Coming to the question, he said, "Even if one has received the boundless grace of Bhagwan and the sadhu, if one sees fault in a devotee, one cannot go to Akshardham."

Question: "Can you put your hand on your heart and say that you have received Bhagwan's boundless grace? Shriji Maharaj says, 'One has met Bhagwan and received boundless grace, but if one sees fault in a devotee, one cannot go to Akshardham.' For example, Lalo Palo."

Now the second question: "Even if he does not serve us, if he speaks of the virtues of devotees, we consider that he has done us the greatest seva." One who sings the praises of Bhagwan and the sadhu and sings the praises of devotees is in Akshardham itself, even if he is far away, in India or abroad. Now the question: "Which of these two will you choose?"
Everyone said together in a loud voice, "Seeing virtues."
"Certain?"
"Yes."
Once again Swamishri asked, "Certain?"
Everyone said "Yes."
Saying this, Swamishri showered beautiful blessings, confirming these two points.
After the chesta, Mahant Swami Maharaj was asked, for his comfort, whether he wanted to stretch out his legs. Swamishri said "Yes."
As soon as the curtain opened, Swamishri said, "Cover my feet with a shawl."
The attendant sadhu asked, "Why? Do you feel cold?"
Swamishri said "No."
The attendant sadhu asked, "Is it because the sadhus are sitting in front, and one should not stretch one's legs out towards sadhus?"
Swamishri said "Yes."
Everyone saw that Swamishri shows such respect even to his disciples and understands their boundless glory.
